label: Reasoning panel
purpose: Stream a reasoning trace along a timeline, then settle it into a summary — available on demand without dominating the answer.
when_to_use: When the model's intermediate steps are worth showing but should stay secondary to the final answer.
when_not_to_use: For a single 'thinking' cue (use ThinkingIndicator) or when the trace must never be shown to the user.
composition: A ghost-Button disclosure trigger with a rotating chevron + step count
A left-ruled timeline of steps (title + detail) that stream in
A Separator and a settled summary once complete
responsive: Full width; the timeline indents from a single ruled edge at every width.
accessibility: the ghost trigger is the only Button and is keyboard-operable with a visible focus ring
steps appear at once and the chevron does not animate under prefers-reduced-motion
anti_patterns: a second primary Button competing with the answer's action
leaving the panel open and streaming with no way to collapse it
rebuilding the disclosure by hand instead of using Collapsible
assumptions: Steps and the summary are DEMO content — replace with the real reasoning trace.
The panel defaults to open for the demo; choose the default that fits the surface.

references.note: assistant-ui's Elements catalogue (https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements, checked 2026-08) is the CONCEPTUAL reference; no code is copied. shadcn has no reasoning/AI block, so the disclosure is composed from real DLS primitives (Collapsible + Button + Separator).
